title: Service to Purpose
blurb: Match each purpose to the Azure service built for it.
source: Microsoft AI-901 (Azure AI Fundamentals) skills-measured guide · in-scope Azure AI services
hint: Drag each purpose onto the service that exists to do it.

items.label: Auto-generate a caption and tags for an uploaded product photo
items.why: Azure AI Vision's Image Analysis feature extracts captions, tags, and objects directly from images.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Vision documentation

items.label: Turn a recorded customer-support call into a written transcript
items.why: Azure AI Speech's speech-to-text recognition converts spoken audio into text.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Speech documentation

items.label: Decide whether hundreds of product reviews are positive or negative
items.why: Azure AI Language's sentiment analysis scores text as positive, negative, neutral, or mixed.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Language documentation

items.label: Translate an incoming support ticket from Japanese into English
items.why: Azure AI Translator performs text translation across dozens of languages in real time.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Translator documentation

items.label: Pull the vendor name, invoice number, and total from a scanned invoice
items.why: Its prebuilt invoice model deterministically extracts known fields from standard form types like invoices and receipts.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Document Intelligence documentation

items.label: Describe the fields you want in plain language and get structured JSON back from a mix of documents, photos, and call recordings
items.why: Content Understanding lets you define an analyzer in natural language and reasons over multimodal input to return structured JSON, unlike Document Intelligence's fixed prebuilt forms.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Content Understanding documentation

items.label: Train a model to spot one specific defect on your factory's assembly-line images
items.why: Custom Vision lets you train an image classifier or object detector on your own labeled images for a narrow, custom task.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Custom Vision documentation

items.label: Verify a person's identity by comparing a selfie against their ID photo
items.why: Azure AI Face provides face detection, verification, and liveness checks for identity scenarios. Verification, identification and liveness are Limited Access features: Microsoft must approve your use case through its intake form before you can call them.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Face service documentation

items.label: Automatically block hateful or violent text before it reaches app users
items.why: Content Safety analyzes text and images for harmful-content categories and severity, then flags or blocks it.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Content Safety documentation

items.label: Spot an unusual spike in a sensor's time-series readings
items.why: Fabric Real-Time Intelligence flags points in streaming or time-series data that deviate from expected patterns. It is Microsoft's recommended home for this job now that Azure AI Anomaly Detector was retired on 1 October 2026.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Anomaly Detector retirement notice · Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence anomaly detection

items.label: Let employees run natural-language search across thousands of internal documents
items.why: Azure AI Search indexes and enriches content so users can query it with keyword and semantic search.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Search documentation

items.label: Extract keywords, faces, and scene changes from an uploaded training video
items.why: Video Indexer analyzes recorded video and audio to surface faces, keywords, topics, and scenes.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Video Indexer documentation

items.label: Deploy GPT-4o inside your own Azure tenant to draft customer-support replies
items.why: Azure OpenAI Service hosts OpenAI's models, like GPT-4o, as an enterprise Azure resource with your own deployment, quota, and content filters.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure OpenAI Service documentation

items.label: One place to deploy a model, build an agent, and evaluate it before shipping
items.why: Microsoft Foundry is the unified platform combining the model catalog, portal, SDK, and Agent Service for building and deploying AI solutions.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Foundry documentation

items.label: Give a model file search, code interpreter, and function-calling tools so it can act across multiple turns
items.why: Foundry Agent Service builds persistent agents combining a model, instructions, tools, and threads for multi-step, stateful tasks, not a single stateless chat call.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure AI Foundry Agent Service documentation

items.label: Train, track, and manage a classic ML model through a full experiment pipeline
items.why: Azure Machine Learning is Microsoft's dedicated platform for traditional ML model training, tracking, and MLOps, distinct from Foundry's generative-AI focus.
items.citation: Microsoft Learn · Azure Machine Learning documentation
